behaviors.context: React app with an existing `<Dialog>` component in `src/components/ui` and an icon set in `src/components/icons`.
behaviors.prompt: Add a confirmation dialog before deleting a project.
must: Reuses the existing Dialog component and icon set
Manages focus when the dialog opens and closes
Makes the dialog keyboard-operable with visible focus
Runs the app and checks the dialog at mobile and larger viewport sizes
mustNot: Uses a Unicode character such as × as the close icon
Describes source inspection alone as a completed visual review

behaviors.prompt: Add a slide-in animation when the notifications panel opens.
must: Honors prefers-reduced-motion for the new animation
Keeps the open and closed states understandable without the motion
mustNot: Audits or changes unrelated animations across the product

behaviors.context: The app currently has a single light theme defined with hard-coded colors in CSS Modules. There is no existing theme preference.
must: Expresses theme values as CSS custom properties
Keeps JavaScript responsible for the user's selection and its persistence
Makes the toggle keyboard and screen-reader accessible
Checks contrast and focus visibility in both themes
mustNot: Synchronizes styles across elements with JavaScript effects

behaviors.context: The email field's invalid state only changes the border color to red.
behaviors.prompt: Fix the email field's error state.
must: Adds a text error message programmatically associated with the field
Makes the error understandable without relying on color alone
mustNot: Expands into an audit of every form in the product
